invariants.rationale: The method explicitly returns a new JavaHoodieBackedTableMetadataWriter, which must be non-null.
The returned object is always constructed as a JavaHoodieBackedTableMetadataWriter.
Result is a new JavaHoodieBackedTableMetadataWriter and cannot be identical to the configuration object.
Result is a writer object, distinct from the write configuration passed as parameter.
The result is a newly constructed writer, not the same as context parameter.
